From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha@carewell.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood — demo request

Hi Ava,

I signed up for Redwood's trial earlier today and wanted to reach out to request a short demo. We're evaluating inference platforms to power an automated patient triage flow in our telehealth product. A few quick details to help you prepare: 

- Use case: patient symptom intake -> suggested triage level and routing to appropriate clinician queues; generating short summaries for triage team.
- Expected volume: ~120k inference requests/month initially, targeting 500k+/month in 6–12 months. Sequence lengths are usually short (avg ~150 tokens).
- Timeline: POC starting late September; decision by end of Q4.

Would love a 30-minute walkthrough of Redwood (runtime, batching, latency, and security/compliance basics). I'm available Tue-Fri next week in the afternoons PDT.

Thanks,
Samantha Nguyen
Head of Product, CareWell
Samantha.N@carewell.io

(On a separate note: I uploaded our SOC checklist in the trial settings — happy to answer any initial questions.)

Hi Samantha — thanks for signing up and for the context, this is super helpful. I’m Ava (SDR on the healthtech vertical) — I can run the intro/demo and loop in our solutions lead if we need a deeper infra discussion.

Quick Qs so we tailor the demo:
- Is the 120k requests/month estimate peak or average? Any burstiness during mornings/evenings?
- Are you planning to host PHI or any patient-identifiable data with inference requests?
- Which model families are you testing today (open weights / commercial models)?
- Who else will join the demo from CareWell (engineering, security, product)?

I have a few windows next week: Wed 8/21 10:00–11:30am PDT, Thu 8/22 1:00–3:00pm PDT, or Fri 8/23 2:30–4:30pm PDT. You can also pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?month=aug-2026

Attaching a one-pager with a quick overview of our Dedicated and Private deployment options — will keep the demo focused on what matters for your POC.

Best,

Hi Ava — thanks for the fast reply and the one-pager. Answers below: 

- 120k is an average month estimate for the POC (expected ramp); peak could be ~3x that during flu season; we do see morning and early evening spikes.
- We will not send PHI during the POC; production will require PHI handling and are open to VPC/Private deployments or dedicated tenancy.
- Currently experimenting with an open-source Llama-2 variant and a commercial 7B model for candidate pipelines.
- Expected demo attendees: myself (product), Raj Patel (engineering manager), and Mei Lin (security/compliance).

All three of us are available Wed 8/21 at 10:30am PDT — that works with your window. Please send the invite and any prep materials.

Looking forward —
